ns2:course.label: Science of Food Preparation
ns2:course.description: Application of food preparation principles and techniques in the preparation of standard food products; principles of food management and their application in the planning and preparation of meals. Additional course fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: FSHN 101 or concurrent registration.
